text:
rachel: ok who told my newt that cardigans are a lifestyle now? this is Newton, he reads spreadsheets and steals my pens. photo: https://imgur.com/a/newt-cardie :sweater: :sob:
noah: absolutely iconic. Frame it. also how does one newt even fit into a cardigan?? :eyes:
sam: Newton looks like he could run the Q2 financials. also stealing pens is peak office culture. :chart_with_upwards_trend: :tada:
leo: camera flex: `Pixel 6a, 1/60s, f/1.7` natural window light + a dab of VSCO. cropped to highlight monocle energy.
rachel: monocle energy confirmed. no actual monocle, just a paperclip and attitude. he sits on my keyboard and blocks zooms until snacks are provided.
noah: can we get an office policy update: "No Newts On Keyboards Unless They Approve The Agenda" :laughing: @people-ops
sam: I'm starting a sticker run. who wants Newton stickers? i can do a sheet with "Newton for CTO" :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
leo: 3 for me. 2 for my home office. rachel, will Newton sign autographs? :pen:
bot-helpers: Reminder: Please keep non-service animals in the office commons crate unless pre-cleared by Facilities. See policy: https://intranet/company/pets-policy
rachel: filing for exception. Newton is a service newt in practice (alerts me to snack time). attaching his tiny resume later. :memo:
sam: vote: Newton for honorary random channel mascot? react with :newt: (if we had one) or :heart: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no. so far: noah :heart:, sam :heart:, leo :heart:, rachel :heart:.
noah: also if anyone wants to borrow Newton's sweater pattern DM me. I knit to de-stress between deploys.
rachel: that pattern is called "cozy spreadsheet" and it has tiny pockets for thumb drives. life-changing.
